summary: Skycorp Solar Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, announcing a $3.6 million second private placement (PIPE) of 1,685,000 Class A ordinary shares at ~$2.14/share, following a prior PIPE bringing total to $6.6M. The price represents a ~30% discount to the reference price. Shares are locked up for six months. The board likely approved the financing to bolster working capital. The filing is a routine capital raise, not a special situation like a return of capital, as the proceeds are for general corporate purposes. No special-situation elements are present, so this is classified as None.
